constraints.locator: Section 6, PDF page 9, Table 2 and Figure 8
constraints.population: Luminous, long-lasting PISN light-curve templates; not all PISNe or specifically Pop III
constraints.selection: Transient detections in multiple seasons; no plausible PISN lasting more than a year
constraints.rate_assumption: Constant volumetric rate with redshift; template-dependent selection from survey simulations
constraints.caveat: Approximately 100 is the authors' order-of-magnitude bound, not a tabulated 95% confidence limit or a redshift-resolved measurement.

not_rate_constraints.description: JADES: 79 supernova candidates, about 25 arcmin2, two discovery epochs separated by one year, about 30 AB mag. The total supernova discovery rate is not a PISN rate at z>10.

not_rate_constraints.reference: Ferrara et al. (2026), Possible evidence for a pair-instability supernova nature of ultra-early JWST sources
not_rate_constraints.description: Historical PISN interpretation of Capotauro at z about 15; superseded by Liu et al. (2026), arXiv:2608.07461v1, whose measured motion rejects an extragalactic source at >6 sigma. Ferrara section VI.2 is a theoretical expected count, not an observed rate.

not_rate_constraints.reference: Liu et al. (2026), A clear detection of proper motion confirms that the claimed z~32 galaxy candidate, Capotauro, is a Y-type brown dwarf
not_rate_constraints.description: NIRCam astrometry measures 132 +/- 20 mas displacement over about 3.5 years, rejecting an extragalactic interpretation including the proposed z~15 PISN at >6 sigma. SED favors a Y-type brown dwarf.
not_rate_constraints.status: PISN interpretation rejected by subsequent astrometry
